publication_native_rule.normalization: divide each single-cell time series by that cell's own arithmetic mean before growth-factor stimulation

prospective_selection_rule: Use every Figure 2 single-pulse group present in the frozen source for all 3, 10, and 60 minute source files. No growth factor, dose, pulse duration, field of view, cell, or time point may be selected because of observed response shape or expected SymC agreement.
execution_rules: verify the exact frozen archive SHA-256 before reading Figure 2 values
merge group labels only by exact group.idx from the matching grouping file
parse realtime and intensity_ekar as finite numeric values
fail on duplicate observations for the same cell key and realtime
compute each cell baseline as arithmetic mean of its observed intensity_ekar values with 0 <= realtime <= 40 minutes
require each included cell to have at least one finite baseline observation and a finite nonzero baseline mean
normalize every observation for that cell by its own baseline mean
at each exact observed realtime within each exact source group, compute the arithmetic mean across available normalized cells
do not interpolate, smooth, impute, resample, trim, winsorize, or exclude a biological trajectory based on its observed response
record cell counts and time-point support so later qualification can distinguish source coverage from biological interpretation
not_reproduced_in_v0_1: 95_percent_confidence_intervals because the exact CI construction is not required for the population-mean observable gate
digitized agreement to rendered Figure 2 curves
forbidden_operations: fit a damped oscillator or select a modal pair
select a favorable growth factor, dose, duration, field of view, cell, or time window after viewing outcomes
scientific_effect: Reproduces the publication-native biological trajectory observable only. Passing this gate is necessary but not sufficient for biological observability, identifiability, reduced-representation invariance, scalar adequacy, or SymC admission.
